body:
weight: light
tier: 0
charter: C2

Land ruling Q2 of specs/factory-step2-followups-v1/RULINGS.md: every ticket declares at least the rail `factory/policy/**`, and a check refuses an open ticket without one. fleet's gate runs `adlc rails-guard --base <start> --ticket <id>`, which exits 1 on a ticket with no rails ("has no rails declared"), so a ticket with `rails: []` spends every strike on a configuration error (specs/factory-step2-followups-v1/records/TB5.md §4.2; upstream voodootikigod/adlc#1272). `factory/policy/**` is the glob factory/bin/lib/ralon-lock.sh protects for every ticket.

Ruling Q1 of specs/factory-run-calls-v1/RULINGS.md: a railed ticket makes the store a frozen trust root (adlc 1.12.0), so every later write, including post-merge's `adlc ticket complete --write --authorize`, refuses with `MANIFEST_KEY_REQUIRED` (exit 2) unless `ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY` is set or `--allow-unsigned` is passed (specs/factory-run-calls-v1/records/TB0.md §2.1). No key exists; the ruling is unsigned, matching `.adlc/config.json` `securityMode: unsigned-fallback`.

Deliverables:
- The desk's ticket convention states the default rail: docs/adr/0002-adlc-sharded-ticket-store.md (where the ADR-0002 header block is defined) and factory/RULES.md say every ticket declares at least `factory/policy/**` in `rails`.
- factory/bin/mirror.sh's ready conditions gain `rails`: an open ticket whose `rails` is empty or missing gets no `ready` and gets `needs-desk` with the reason `rails: none declared`.
- The ticket check behind `make tickets` (or the existing desk check; the records cite which) fails on an open ticket without rails.
- Completed tickets are never relabeled for it (T1-T16 have no rails and stay as they are).
- tests/fakes/adlc carries `rails` through `ticket show`.
- factory/bin/post-merge.sh passes `--allow-unsigned` to `adlc ticket complete --write --authorize` (ruling Q1), and tests/fakes/adlc refuses a railed store's write without it, as the real CLI does.

Acceptance criteria:
1. An open ticket with `rails: []` gets `needs-desk` with the reason `rails: none declared`. Verify: `make test` (tests/test_mirror.sh).
2. An open ticket with the rail can be `ready`. Verify: `make test` (tests/test_mirror.sh).
3. A completed ticket without rails is untouched. Verify: `make test` (tests/test_mirror.sh).
4. The ticket check fails on an open ticket without rails and passes on the store as it stands. Verify: `make test` and `make tickets`.
5. post-merge completes a ticket in a railed store: it passes `--allow-unsigned`, and the fake adlc refuses the same write without it (exit 2, `MANIFEST_KEY_REQUIRED`). Verify: `make test` (tests/test_post_merge.sh).
6. The convention is written down. Verify: `grep -n "factory/policy/\*\*" factory/RULES.md docs/adr/0002-adlc-sharded-ticket-store.md`.
7. shellcheck -S warning clean. Verify: `make lint`.

Out of scope: editing tickets T1-T16; editing anything under factory/policy/; a manifest signing key or any workflow secret; step 3's CI desk gate; any write to GitHub.
title: Make factory/policy/** every ticket's default rail and refuse an open ticket without rails (ruling Q2)
